ch12-open.title: Laser pointer
ch12-open.standfirst: Point without leaving a mark. The laser is a temporary dot every participant sees, ideal for walking the room through a drawing.

c12-laser.heading: Point at the canvas without drawing on it
c12-laser.lead: Pick the laser pointer from the toolbar and your cursor becomes a glowing dot that everyone in the room sees in real time. It's perfect for “look here” — walking people through a plan or a model without adding anything permanent.
c12-laser.body: Unlike a pen stroke, the laser leaves nothing behind: the trail fades as you move and disappears when you switch tools, so the canvas stays clean.
